s5860-24xmg.note: Ports 1 to 24 are 10GBASE-T copper, 25 to 28 SFP+ and 29 to 32 SFP28, all at their default speed (auto, auto, 25G). The SFP28 ports are one speed group: PicOS commits all four at 25G (or unset) or all four at 10G or 1G and refuses a mix ("all 4 ports te-1/1/29, te-1/1/30, te-1/1/31, te-1/1/32 in one group set either 25G or 10G/1G", measured 2026-10-26), so 1G modules go in 25 to 28.
